name: Redwood Group Ltd
summary: Redwood Group Ltd, along with its various divisions, specializes in providing interior design and fit-out services for luxury retail boutiques across Asia, the Middle East, the United States, and Europe. The company also serves as a bespoke manufacturer, producing custom interior elements for high-end brands. Its expertise further extends to the conception, fabrication, and distribution of artisanal craftsmanship, metalwork, specialized carpentry, and a diverse range of other interior furnishing products. The firm, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, was established in 1992.
